metadata.title: Dungeons & Dragons Starter Set: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle

adventure.summary: Adventurers explore the island of Stormwreck Isle amidst a conflict between chromatic and metallic dragons. They investigate the cloister of Dragon's Rest, the Sea Caves, a Cursed Shipwreck, and the Clifftop Observatory to prevent a dragon war and uncover powerful magic.
adventure.background: Two dragon families, metallic and chromatic, descended from Bahamut and Tiamat, have a long-standing animosity. The island was formed by undersea volcanic activity caused by the ancient red dragon Sharruth. Runara, an adult bronze dragon in human form, leads the cloister at Dragon's Rest to promote peace but threats from dragons and undead sailors confront the characters.

hooks.description: Adventurers come to Dragon's Rest seeking purpose, knowledge, or peace and are drawn into the island's draconic conflicts.
Investigate recent shipwrecks and attacks near Stormwreck Isle caused by a cursed talisman and undead sailors.
Aid the myconids in the Sea Caves who are suffering from a blight due to volcanic fumes from the red dragon tomb beneath the island.
Confront the blue dragon wyrmling Sparkrender at the Clifftop Observatory and prevent his ritual to enslave dragon spirits.

quests.name: Investigate Dragon's Rest and island threats
quests.description: Begin your adventure at Dragon's Rest cloister. Interact with the inhabitants, learn about island dangers, and accept quests.
objectives: Meet Elder Runara and the residents
Defeat zombies at the beach if encountered
Explore Dragon's Rest locations
Undertake quests related to the Sea Caves, Shipwreck, and Clifftop Observatory

quests.name: Stop the zombie resurgence
quests.description: Respond to reports of zombie attacks near Dragon's Rest and defeat waves of zombies threatening the community.
objectives: Defeat zombies attacking Blepp and Tarak
Investigate source of undead on the island

quests.name: Help the myconids in Seagrow Caves
quests.description: Visit the Sea Caves to help the myconids suffering from blight due to volcanic fumes and defend them against hostile creatures.
objectives: Navigate to the Sea Caves by boat or coastal walk
Communicate with and aid the myconids
Defeat fungal octopus guardian and hostile stirges
Destroy the orange crystal blocking the fumes vent
Bring heart cap mushrooms to Tarak
rewards: Elixir of Health crafted by Tarak

quests.name: Investigate the cursed shipwreck Compass Rose
quests.description: Explore the shipwreck site to end the curse causing zombie sailors to arise and stop the harpy luring ships to their doom.
objectives: Travel to Compass Rose shipwreck
Explore main deck, captain's quarters, lower deck, and hold
Defeat zombies and ghoul aboard
Confront and resolve the harpy threat
Recover or destroy Aleitha's talisman to end the curse

quests.name: Confront Sparkrender at the Clifftop Observatory
quests.description: Explore the ruins of the Clifftop Observatory to stop Sparkrender's ritual plan, rescue the bronze wyrmling Aidron, and confront the blue dragon wyrmling.
objectives: Travel to Clifftop Observatory
Activate magical bridges using the moonstone key
Navigate kobold defenses and stirges in the area
Choose to fight Sparkrender directly or rescue Aidron first
Disrupt Sparkrender's ritual using dragon effigies and sculpture
Defeat Sparkrender and free Aidron
rewards: Magic items: +1 Battleaxe or Spell Scroll of Hold Person

quests.name: Rescue Aidron, the lost bronze wyrmling
quests.description: Aidron fled Dragon's Rest for the observatory after rejecting Runara's teachings and was imprisoned there by Sparkrender.
objectives: Free Aidron from chains in the secret library
Help Aidron confront Sparkrender

AREA:1.name: Dragon's Rest Cloister
AREA:1.description: A peaceful cloister atop a cliff on the north side of Stormwreck Isle, led by Elder Runara (a disguised bronze dragon). Home to a small community dominated by kobolds and a few humans.
AREA:1.notes: Serves as the home base and hub for adventurers exploring the island. The temple is a focal point for peace, magic, and culture.

AREA:2.name: Seagrow Caves
AREA:2.description: A network of dark caves inhabited by a colony of myconids afflicted by a poisonous blight caused by volcanic fumes leaking from beneath the island.
AREA:2.notes: Features include bioluminescent fungi, a fungus servant octopus guardian, stirges nesting in the caves, and an orange crystal blocking a vent.

AREA:3.name: Cursed Shipwreck (Compass Rose)
AREA:3.description: Wreck of an old ship, homes to zombie sailors and a harpy that lures victims to their deaths. The ship carries a cursed talisman causing the undead menace.
AREA:3.notes: Dark and dangerous, requires investigation to lift the curse and deal with monsters onboard.

AREA:4.name: Clifftop Observatory
AREA:4.description: Ruined observatory atop basalt spires with magical bridges. Currently occupied by blue dragon wyrmling Sparkrender and his kobold followers.
AREA:4.notes: Site of Sparkrender's ritual to bind dragon spirits, includes puzzles with statues and star maps, secret archives, and the imprisonment of bronze wyrmling Aidron.

ROOM:1A.name: Path and Monastic Cells
ROOM:1A.description: Path up cliffside with garden plots and six cells cut into cliff face for cloister residents.
features: Dragon statue of bronze dragon Astalagan
Six monastic cells with beds and furnishings

ROOM:1B.name: Winch House
ROOM:1B.description: Small building housing a winch with a pallet to bring supplies up and down the cliff.

ROOM:1C.name: Kitchen and Dining Room
ROOM:1C.description: Dining area with long table, benches, and a nearby kitchen used by cloister residents for meals.

ROOM:1D.name: Library
ROOM:1D.description: Large library with shelves of theology and history books, writing tables, and quiet study.

ROOM:1E.name: Temple of Bahamut
ROOM:1E.description: Open-air stone temple on cliff edge with a statue of Bahamut surrounded by canaries. Place of serenity and protected by magic.
features: Protective magic granting +d4 to saving throws for non-evil creatures

ROOM:2B1.name: Entrance Tunnel
ROOM:2B1.description: Bioluminescent fungus covers tunnel walls, flooded at high tide. Contains water and a spore servant octopus guardian.

ROOM:2B2.name: Fungus Farm
ROOM:2B2.description: Large cavern filled with various fungi and myconids tending mushrooms.

ROOM:2B3.name: Larder
ROOM:2B3.description: Filthy cavern with decaying vegetation, mushroom folk working, and a stirge nest.

ROOM:2B4.name: Circle Chamber
ROOM:2B4.description: Cavern with giant mushrooms arranged in a circle where adult myconids meditate or rest.

ROOM:2B5.name: Sinensa's Sanctum
ROOM:2B5.description: Small cavern glowing with fungus and crystals housing the unconscious myconid leader Sinensa and caretakers.

ROOM:2B6.name: Crystal Cave
ROOM:2B6.description: Choked with orange smoke and light from an orange crystal blocking a fissure; home to fume drakes and a fire snake

ROOM:3C1.name: Main Deck
ROOM:3C1.description: The deteriorated top deck of the Compass Rose shipwreck anchoring supplies and danger.
features: Stairs to upper and lower decks

ROOM:3C2.name: Forecastle
ROOM:3C2.description: Broken foremast with a non-functional ballista.

ROOM:3C3.name: Quarterdeck
ROOM:3C3.description: Rear deck with ship's wheel bearing the ship name.
features: Ship's wheel that can be dropped causing noise and attracting zombies

ROOM:3C4.name: Captain's Quarters
ROOM:3C4.description: Barricaded quarters containing two zombie sailors and a hole leading to the hold.
features: Jagged hole in floor beneath bed

ROOM:3C5.name: Galley
ROOM:3C5.description: Kitchen area with headless skeleton remains and harmless crabs.

ROOM:3C6.name: Crew Quarters
ROOM:3C6.description: Sleeping quarters with six double bunks and a painted portrait.

ROOM:3C7.name: Mess Hall
ROOM:3C7.description: Dining room with long table and broken crockery.

ROOM:3C8.name: Lower Deck
ROOM:3C8.description: Wet, submerged deck with zombies and a lurking ghoul.
features: Hole in ceiling connects to captain's quarters

ROOM:3C9.name: Hold
ROOM:3C9.description: Submerged hold with captain's chest containing magical items and treasure.
features: Captain's chest releases magical pouch and journal

ROOM:4D1.name: Overlook
ROOM:4D1.description: Cliff edge marked by two marble dragon statues with slots for the moonstone key to open magical bridges.

ROOM:4D2.name: Rotunda Ruins
ROOM:4D2.description: Plaza of broken stone, typed sculptures representing dragons with ongoing stirge battle.

ROOM:4D3.name: Kobold Camp
ROOM:4D3.description: Rope bridge to a small tower occupied by hostile kobolds and winged kobolds.
features: Patrol and maintenance of the observatory ruins

ROOM:4D4.name: Isolated Study
ROOM:4D4.description: Cramped tower with collapsed floor and scattered books, containing a trapped scholar's journal.
features: Hidden compartment with potion and gold

ROOM:4D5.name: Observatory Tower
ROOM:4D5.description: Tall tower with ruined stained-glass dome and star map. Home and lair to blue dragon wyrmling Sparkrender.

ROOM:4D6.name: Secret Library
ROOM:4D6.description: Hidden archive sealed by a caved-in wall containing imprisoned bronze wyrmling Aidron.

NPC:ELDER_RUNARA.role: Leader of Dragon's Rest, adult bronze dragon in human form
NPC:ELDER_RUNARA.description: Disguised as an elderly human woman, wise and peace-loving, committed to reconciliation between chromatic and metallic dragons.
NPC:ELDER_RUNARA.personality: Indifferent initially, friendly after help is shown to cloister, hostile if harmed.
NPC:ELDER_RUNARA.goals: Promote peace and help characters overcome island threats.

NPC:KOBOLDS.description: Small reptilian humanoids, mostly lawful good followers of Runara. Nine kobolds with various personalities.
NPC:KOBOLDS.personality: Range from indifferent to friendly or rude, provide comic relief and information.

NPC:TARAK.description: Soft-spoken, knowledgeable, wrestling with past crimes.

NPC:VARNOTH.description: Gruff but empathetic, believes in second chances.
NPC:VARNOTH.personality: Indifferent at first, can become friendly through conversation.

NPC:MYLA.description: Inventive, curious, experimenting with alchemy and magic, followers of Sparkrender.

NPC:BLEPP.description: Convinced of his luck and magical dagger.
NPC:BLEPP.goals: Stay safe and prove his luck.

NPC:MUMPO.description: Stole a copper piece from Runara's hoard.

NPC:KOBOLDS_MEK_MINN.description: Cruel and haughty, responsible for preparing observatory for ritual.
NPC:KOBOLDS_MEK_MINN.personality: Hostile to outsiders, loyal to their dragon boss.

NPC:KOBOLDS_SPARKRENDER_ALLIES.description: Cruel and hostile, can be intimidated or persuaded with charisma.

MON:ZOMBIE.name: Zombie
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces a zombie to 0 hp, it makes a DC 5 + damage taken Constitution saving throw; on success, drops to 1 hit point instead (except radiant damage or critical hit).

MON:ZOMBIE.description: Mindless reanimated corpses of drowned sailors serving a cursed talisman.
MON:ZOMBIE.tactics: Slow moving melee attackers, resilient to damage.
MON:ZOMBIE.location: Dragon's Rest beach, Compass Rose shipwreck

MON:FUME_DRAKE.name: Fume Drake

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When it dies, it explodes in a cloud of noxious fumes; creatures within 5 feet must succeed DC 11 Constitution save or take 1d8 poison damage.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.description: Does not require food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Scalding Breath
actions.description: DC 11 Dexterity saving throw for half damage. Recharge 6.

MON:FUME_DRAKE.description: Mischievous elementary creature formed from dead dragon magic, composed of greenish smoke.
MON:FUME_DRAKE.tactics: Causes confusion and pain, attacks intruders.

MON:BLUE_DRAGON_WYRMLING.name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling

actions.name: Lightning Breath
actions.description: DC 12 Dexterity saving throw for half damage. Recharge 5-6.

MON:BLUE_DRAGON_WYRMLING.description: Vain, territorial blue dragon wyrmling with lightning breath and repulsion ability.
MON:BLUE_DRAGON_WYRMLING.tactics: Uses breath weapon and claws. Flight and melee in combat.

MON:BRONZE_DRAGON_RUNARA.name: Runara (Adult Bronze Dragon)

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Can choose to succeed a saving throw it fails.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Breath Weapon
actions.description: Exhales either lightning or Repulsion Breath (pushes creatures away). DC 19 save. Recharge 5-6.

MON:BRONZE_DRAGON_RUNARA.description: Adult bronze dragon disguised as human woman Runara, leader of Dragon's Rest.
MON:BRONZE_DRAGON_RUNARA.tactics: Powerful combatant with area breath attacks and shape change abilities.

MON:BRONZE_DRAGON_WYRMLING.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Breath Weapons
actions.range: 40 ft. line 5 ft. wide or 30 ft. cone
actions.description: Lightning Breath: DC 12 Dexterity save for 16 (3d10) lightning damage, Repulsion Breath: DC 12 Strength save or pushed 30 ft. Recharge 5-6.

MON:BRONZE_DRAGON_WYRMLING.description: Young bronze dragon wyrmling, loyal to Runara and imprisoned in the observatory by Sparkrender.
MON:BRONZE_DRAGON_WYRMLING.tactics: Uses breath weapons and melee, tries to aid players if freed.

MON:FIRE_SNAKE.name: Fire Snake

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.description: A creature that touches the snake or hits it with a melee attack within 5 feet takes 1d6 fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One bite and one tail attack.

MON:FIRE_SNAKE.description: Larval salamander elemental with fire immunity, cold vulnerability, and fiery attacks.
MON:FIRE_SNAKE.tactics: Attacks intruders emerging from egg, hostile and defensive.

MON:GHOUL.name: Ghoul

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Target other than elf or undead must succeed on DC 10 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. Save repeats end of turns.

MON:GHOUL.description: Flesh-eating undead lurking in shipwreck hold, uses paralysis and attacks in packs.
MON:GHOUL.tactics: Attacks with bite and claws, attempts to paralyze foes.

MON:HARPY.name: Harpy

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One claw and one club attack.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.description: Targets must succeed on DC 11 Wisdom Save or be charmed and move towards harpy. Charmed targets are incapacitated, can repeat save each turn.

MON:HARPY.description: Cruel monstrosity with vulture body and human torso that enchants with song.
MON:HARPY.tactics: Uses Luring Song to charm and lure victims into danger.

MON:KOBOLD.name: Kobold

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet and not incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight while in sunlight.

MON:KOBOLD.description: Small reptilian humanoids skilled with pack tactics and sunlight sensitivity.
MON:KOBOLD.tactics: Use hit-and-run tactics, support each other in combat.
MON:KOBOLD.location: Dragon's Rest, Clifftop Observatory, area D3

MON:KOBOLD_TINKERER.name: Kobold Tinkerer

traits.name: Inquiring Mind (1/Day)
traits.description: Can cast detect magic without spell components using Intelligence.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if an ally is within 5 feet.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks in sunlight.

actions.name: Alchemical Flame
actions.description: DC 12 Dexterity saving throw for half damage. Recharge 6.

MON:KOBOLD_TINKERER.description: Winged kobold tinkerer skilled in magic and alchemy.

MON:WINGED_KOBOLD.name: Winged Kobold

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if an ally is within 5 feet.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks in sunlight.

MON:WINGED_KOBOLD.description: Small flying kobolds with pack tactics.

MON:MYCONID_SPROUT.name: Myconid Sprout

traits.name: Distress Spores
traits.description: When taking damage, alerts other myconids within 240 feet.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.description: Disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, saving throws in sunlight, dies after 1 hour of sun exposure.

actions.name: Rapport Spores
actions.description: Allows telepathic communication for 1 hour, excluding undead, constructs, elementals.

MON:MYCONID_SPROUT.description: Small intelligent fungi living in caves practicing melds.

MON:MYCONID_ADULT.name: Myconid Adult

traits.name: Distress Spores
traits.description: When taking damage, alerts other myconids within 240 feet.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.description: Disadvantage on ability, attack rolls, saving throws in sunlight, dies after 1 hour exposure.

actions.name: Pacifying Spores (3/Day)
actions.description: DC 11 Constitution saving throw or stunned for 1 minute, save repeats end of turns.

actions.name: Rapport Spores
actions.description: Allows telepathic communication for 1 hour, excluding undead, constructs, elementals.

MON:MYCONID_ADULT.description: Adult fungi that lead myconid colonies and protect sprouts.

MON:SINENSA.name: Sinensa

traits.name: Distress Spores
traits.description: Alerts all myconids within 240 feet when taking damage.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.description: Disadvantage on ability checks, attacks, and saves in sunlight. Dies after 1 hour exposure.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One fist attack and use of hallucination spores.

actions.name: Hallucination Spores
actions.description: Target must succeed on DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned and incapacitated by hallucinations for 1 minute; save repeats end of turns.

MON:SINENSA.description: Leader of the myconid colony, large and ill from blight.

MON:OWLBEAR.name: Owlbear

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.description: Has advantage on Perception checks relying on sight or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One beak and one claw attack.

MON:OWLBEAR.description: Fierce predator with owl head and bear body.
MON:OWLBEAR.tactics: Relies on superior senses and brute strength.

MON:SPORE_SERVANT_OCTOPUS.name: Spore Servant Octopus

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: Can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: Can breathe only underwater.

MON:SPORE_SERVANT_OCTOPUS.description: Reanimated dead giant octopus controlled by myconid spores.

MON:STIRGE.name: Stirge

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.description: Upon hit, attaches to target. Target loses 1d4+3 hp at start of stirge's turns. Detaches after draining 10 hp or when target dies. Can be detached by target or creature using action.

MON:STIRGE.description: Winged parasite feeding on blood with hooked claws.

ITEM:Boots_of_Elvenkind.description: While wearing, footsteps make no sound and user has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks relying on silent movement.

ITEM:Elixir_of_Health.description: Cures disease and removes blinded, deafened, paralyzed, and poisoned conditions.
ITEM:Elixir_of_Health.location: Crafted by Tarak from ruby morel mushroom

ITEM:Potion_of_Healing.location: Given by Runara and found in adventure

ITEM:Potion_of_Resistance.description: Grants resistance to one damage type for 1 hour. Type determined by DM.

ITEM:Spell_Scroll_Command.description: Allows casting the Command spell without components if on user's class list.
ITEM:Spell_Scroll_Command.location: Crate contents on shipwreck lower deck

ITEM:Talisman.description: Formed from braided hair of Aleitha and Brastos, carries necromancy magic and causes undead curse on shipwreck.
ITEM:Talisman.location: Captain's Chest, Compass Rose shipwreck hold

ITEM:Moonstone_Key.description: Hexagonal prism key with dragon's head engraving, used to activate magical bridges in the Clifftop Observatory.
ITEM:Moonstone_Key.location: Given by Runara at Dragon's Rest

ITEM:Heart_Cap_Mushrooms.description: Red mushroom resembling human hearts, used by Tarak to make healing potions.

events.description: Runara rescues the adventurers if they are defeated by zombies at the beach.
events.outcome: Adventurers wake up healed and tended by kobolds.

events.description: Shattering the orange crystal in Crystal Cave releases fire snake and clears toxic fumes blighting myconids.
events.outcome: Blight ends and myconids' attitude improves.

events.description: The harpy returns to the shipwreck when conditions such as discovery of captain's chest or resting on the ship occur.
events.outcome: Harpy confronts characters with Luring Song attack.

events.description: Sparkrender performs ritual to bind dragon spirits if not stopped by adventurers.
events.outcome: Ritual causes random magical effects; characters must disrupt or kill Sparkrender.

triggers.condition: Character pulls lever in winch house
triggers.effect: Pallet falls to water and must be winched back up

triggers.condition: Character mishandles ship's wheel in Compass Rose
triggers.effect: Wheel falls to deck with noise, attracting zombies to main deck

triggers.condition: Wheel crashes or loud noises attract zombies
triggers.effect: Zombies attack characters and make repeated attacks on door

triggers.condition: Orange crystal shattered in Crystal Cave
triggers.effect: Fire snake is released and noxious fumes vent, ending blight

traps.trigger: Floorboard in Crew Quarters lifted improperly
traps.effect: Dart attack +5 to hit, 1d4 (2) piercing damage, DC 11 Constitution save or 3 (1d6) poison damage
traps.disarm: Lift floorboard from safe distance or carefully scratch rune on journal

traps.trigger: Attempt to open scholar's journal in Isolated Study without disarming
traps.effect: Spews poisonous green gas, 3 (1d6) poison damage
traps.disarm: Scratch over rune with dagger or sharp object, DC 11 Intelligence (Arcana) check
